types.mode_data: object: exactly one qualification|timing|allocation key, selected by identity.mode; allocation contains calibration and retention

required.run_id: canonical UUID string, fresh per launch
required.nonce: canonical UUID string, fresh and distinct from run_id

identity.identity_rule: Host summary and frozen plan must equal every native identity field; stale result, stale binary, wrong arm/tracking/mode/source/fixture/build/contract/os is INCONCLUSIVE.

receipt.rule: completions is the receiver completion delta; native_completions is the URLSession delegate/completion callback receipt; protocol/invalidation/errors are callback-derived. Expected loop counts are separate fields and never replace callback receipts

completed_task_control.isolation_rule: Run after all timing/allocation/retention epochs on a dedicated feature, then invalidate/drop task and release the feature before final teardown. Baseline orphan never enters numeric cohorts.

teardown.rule: Concrete class and equal nonzero IMPs before/after; retire each probe task/session with actual invalidation and weak settlement. Do not require literal class URLSessionTask or unequal before/after IMPs.

final_release.rule: Capture all weak witnesses while strong references are nonnil, perform intended release, then require nil. Deliberate hold controls are separate and cannot make this vacuous.

required.controls: object containing task_hold, feature_hold and payload_continuation

qualification.scope: four iOS 17.5 cells A/B x automatic/registered; no rows, allocation calibration, retention or P01/P02/P03 credit

boundary_labels.first_resume_through_flush: resume through immediate feature flush (already-enqueued SDK work); not fully settled

timing.receipt_rule: Second resume has native_task_lifecycles=7000, resume_calls=14000, outstanding_enters=7000 and outstanding_leaves=7000; all other applicable phases retain separate callback receipts. The unbound row identifier is exactly unbound_first_resume.

allocation_retention.calibration_order: calibrate caller/feature queue/worker/concurrent observer before any allocation row including unbound; timing/qualification never install logger; emit mode_data.allocation.calibration.completed=true, calibration_before_unbound=true and a nested passes object

full_task_cycle.scope: first resume through native completion/invalidation/final feature flush

diagnostics.full_lifetime_churn: raw only, includes construction/pool exit/weak settlement and is retained at mode_data.allocation.full_lifetime_churn
diagnostics.idle_control: raw only and retained at mode_data.allocation.idle_control

retention.candidate_only: B inventories contain nested preparations {raw_count_before_enumeration,live_weak_keys,remaining_values,phase_payloads,events,continuations} and weak_terminal_tasks {raw_count_before_enumeration,live_members}

allocation_retention.epoch_rule: No beforeReceipts dictionary/map growth or expected-loop bookkeeping inside measured epochs; preallocated scalar callback receipts only. Allocation row receipts are one aggregated receipt object over allocation_batch_0 through allocation_batch_6, while every batch retains its own receipt object.

matrix_and_verdict_boundary.numeric_after: all 32 cells valid and all seven applicable rows/receipts present
matrix_and_verdict_boundary.host_preserves: local.json byte-for-byte; evaluator verdict is separate

offline_negative_controls: equal IMP restoration accepted; unequal before/after rejected
baseline completed-resume mutation treated as candidate failure

source_mapping.evaluator_boundary: Evaluator consumes this shape without rewriting native raw output.
